_comment: DEP / ABM Token Resource Definition (Phase 8 — Future)
_description: Defines monitoring for Apple Device Enrollment Program (DEP) and Apple Business Manager (ABM) tokens.
displayName: Apple Device Enrollment Program (DEP / ABM) Token
description: DEP/ABM tokens authorize Microsoft Intune to manage Apple devices enrolled through Apple Business Manager or Apple School Manager.

businessImpact.summary: DEP token expiry prevents automatic enrollment of new Apple devices through ABM/ASM.

steps: Navigate to Microsoft Intune Admin Center
Go to Devices > Enroll Devices > Apple Enrollment > Enrollment Program Tokens
Sign in to Apple Business Manager with the Apple ID associated with the token
Upload the new token to Intune
